tools.name: fiji_context
tools.description: Read Fiji’s real state: the active image (id, title, width/height, channels/slices/frames, bit depth, calibration unit, unsaved changes), open images, the active ROI, overlay/ROI Manager/Results counts, and the viewer (magnification, visible srcRect in image px, canvas screen rectangle). Refresh before resolving “this”, “here” or any mutation.

tools.name: fiji_images
tools.description: List open images with ids, titles, sizes, which one is active and whether each has unsaved changes.

tools.name: fiji_open_path
tools.description: Open an exact absolute local image path in Fiji (IJ.openImage, Bio-Formats importer for microscopy formats). A Bio-Formats/Open dialog with default settings is confirmed for you; any other dialog is reported for fiji_ui. Returns the opened image and a highlight; re-read fiji_context to verify the active image. Dispatch is not completion.

tools.name: fiji_activate_image
tools.description: Bring an open image window to the front by id or title and make it the active image. Display only.

id.description: ImageJ image id exactly as fiji_context/fiji_images report it (ImageJ ids are negative integers).

tools.name: fiji_select_roi
tools.description: Set the active selection (ROI) in image pixels: rectangle or oval by x, y, width, height; polygon or line by points [[x,y],…]; point by x, y; none clears it. Infer the region from viewer.srcRect or the image size, never ask for coordinates. The view zooms to a ROI that would be invisible. Returns the ROI and a highlight.

tools.name: fiji_roi_manager
tools.description: List ROI Manager entries (index, name, type, bounds). Bounded by limit; total is untruncated.

tools.name: fiji_add_to_manager
tools.description: Add the active ROI to the ROI Manager. Returns its index and the new total.

tools.name: fiji_measure
tools.description: Measure with ImageJ (Analyze > Measure): configures Set Measurements from names (area, mean, min, max, perimeter, shape, integrated, median, centroid, feret, …) and measures the active ROI (scope roi), every ROI Manager entry (manager, multi-measure) or the whole image (all). Returns rows, columns, the last row and per-column min/max/mean summaries. Numbers come from here, never from appearance.

tools.name: fiji_results
tools.description: Read Results table rows (bounded by limit and offset) with their column names.

tools.name: fiji_clear_results
tools.description: Clear the Results table.

tools.name: fiji_threshold
tools.description: Threshold the active image or ROI: an automatic method (Otsu, Default, Huang, Li, Triangle, Moments, MaxEntropy, Yen, …; dark true for bright objects on a dark background) or explicit lower/upper bounds. Returns the lower/upper values applied and a highlight. For “stricter” raise the lower bound (narrower range) from the last result, for “looser” lower it, then run fiji_analyze_particles again.

tools.name: fiji_analyze_particles
tools.description: Count and outline objects in the thresholded image (Analyze > Analyze Particles): minSize/maxSize in calibrated units², minCircularity 0–1, exclude edge particles, include holes, show Outlines/Masks/Nothing, addToManager (default true), summarize. Returns count, totalArea, averageSize and a highlight of up to 120 particles.

tools.name: fiji_segment_cells
tools.description: One-step cell/nucleus segmentation of the active image: duplicate → 8-bit → Gaussian 1 → auto threshold (method, default Otsu) → fill holes → watershed (default true) → Analyze Particles on the original, adding every cell to the ROI Manager. Pick channel and minSize yourself from the image. Returns count, the steps taken (macro-equivalent) and a highlight; follow with fiji_measure scope manager for areas and intensities.

tools.name: fiji_track_objects
tools.description: Follow cells, nuclei, protein puncta or particles through a time-lapse: detect objects in every frame (auto threshold, method default Otsu; dark true for bright objects on dark), link them frame to frame (maxDistance px/frame, maxGap frames, minLength frames) and draw the trajectories on the overlay. Pick channel, sizes and distances yourself from the image. Returns tracks, objects per frame, mean speed/displacement/path length with units, divisions, the top tracks and a “Tracks” table.

tools.name: fiji_intensity_over_time
tools.description: Mean intensity of the active ROI (scope active) or ROI Manager entries (scope manager, optional indices) in every frame: protein expression kinetics, FRAP recovery, photobleaching. Returns per-ROI first/last/min/max, percent change, peak frame and values, plus a bleaching estimate when measurable.

tools.name: fiji_tumor_region
tools.description: Outline the tumour or tissue region of a section (H&E, IHC or fluorescence; stain auto picks colour deconvolution for brightfield): smooth (sigma) → threshold (method) → keep the largest regions (keepLargest, minAreaFraction of the image) → add to the ROI Manager. Returns regions, area, area fraction of the image, perimeter, circularity, solidity, mean intensity, the steps and a highlight.

tools.name: fiji_colocalize
tools.description: Colocalisation of two channels (channelA/channelB) of the active image, or two open images (imageA/imageB ids), inside the active ROI when roi is true: Pearson’s r, Manders’ M1/M2 above thresholds (auto method or explicit thresholdA/thresholdB), overlap and ICQ. Read only. Correlation is not interaction; say which thresholds were used.

imageA.description: ImageJ image id exactly as fiji_context/fiji_images report it (ImageJ ids are negative integers).

imageB.description: ImageJ image id exactly as fiji_context/fiji_images report it (ImageJ ids are negative integers).

tools.name: fiji_classify_intensity
tools.description: Score every ROI Manager object (usually cells from fiji_segment_cells) as positive or negative for a marker by its mean/intdens/median/max in a channel, against an explicit threshold or an auto method on the per-cell values: Ki67 index, protein-positive cells. Returns total, positive, negative, percent positive, the threshold used and a highlight of the positives. Label is the marker name (“Ki67”).

tools.name: fiji_object_stats
tools.description: Summarise the objects in the ROI Manager: count, area/intensity/circularity mean, median, SD, min and max, an area histogram and the largest and smallest objects with a highlight. Opens a “Size distribution” histogram plot window (plot, default true) — the answer to “show me the size distribution”. Read only.

tools.name: fiji_filter_objects
tools.description: Remove unwanted detections from the ROI Manager and overlay without re-segmenting: remove "tiny" (default: area below fraction 0.35 of the median), "huge" (above 3× median), or explicit minArea/maxArea (calibrated units²) and minCircularity. The answer to “remove the tiny ones / the debris / the specks”. Returns before, removed, kept and a highlight.

tools.name: fiji_split_objects
tools.description: Separate touching or merged cells: watershed inside oversized objects (area above factor × median, default 1.5), inside objects within the active selection, or the given ROI Manager indices; pieces replace the merged object. The answer to “those cells are touching, separate them”. Returns before, after, split and a highlight of the new pieces.

tools.name: fiji_filter
tools.description: Apply an ImageJ filter to the active image or ROI: gaussian/median/mean (radius or sigma), unsharp, subtract_background (rolling radius), enhance_contrast (saturated %), invert, smooth, sharpen, find_edges. Changes pixels; a checkpoint is taken first.

tools.name: fiji_convert
tools.description: Convert the active image type: 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, RGB, Composite or Grayscale; splitChannels splits a multichannel image into separate windows.

tools.name: fiji_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate the active image, or only its ROI, into a new window with an optional title. Returns the new image.

tools.name: fiji_zoom
tools.description: Change the view of the active image: direction in/out (one ImageJ zoom step), fit true to fit the window, or an exact magnification, optionally centred on image pixel x, y. Returns the viewer state. Display only.

tools.name: fiji_highlight
tools.description: Visibly point at what you are talking about, like a presenter: ROI Manager entries/particles (rois manager, optionally indices), the active ROI (active), both (all) or an image-pixel rectangle. Penny flies its cursor there with a short label; the view zooms to targets that would otherwise be invisible. Display only.

label.description: Two to six words shown beside the cursor, e.g. "64 cells".

tools.name: fiji_overlay
tools.description: Show or hide the image overlay, load the ROI Manager entries into it (fromManager), clear it, or toggle labels. Returns the overlay count. Display only.

tools.name: fiji_display
tools.description: Brightness/contrast and lookup table (display only): min/max, auto range, lut name (Grays, Fire, Red, Green, Blue, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, HiLo, …) and the channel of a composite.

tools.name: fiji_stack
tools.description: Navigate a stack or hyperstack: slice, channel, frame (1-based; the current position is image.position in fiji_context). Display only.

tools.name: fiji_project_stack
tools.description: Z-project the active stack (max, sum or avg intensity) into a new image.

tools.name: fiji_commands
tools.description: Search Fiji’s menu commands (ImageJ1 menus and SciJava commands) by name: returns name, menuPath and source. Search before fiji_run_command and use the exact name.

tools.name: fiji_run_command
tools.description: Run an exact menu command by name (from fiji_commands) with an ImageJ options string, e.g. "Blobs (25K)" or "Gaussian Blur..." with "sigma=2". If a dialog opens and stays, the result reports dispatched:true with the dialog’s controls: set them with fiji_ui_action and press OK. Dispatch is not completion; re-read context. File and plugin side effects may not be reversible.

tools.name: fiji_ui
tools.description: Inspect visible Fiji/ImageJ windows (AWT/Swing): dialogs, buttons, text fields, checkboxes, choices and sliders with ids, values, disabled state and screen bounds. Use for GenericDialogs after a command. Excludes other applications and OS-owned dialogs.

tools.name: fiji_ui_action
tools.description: Operate a control seen by fiji_ui: fire presses a button, set_text edits a field, select chooses a choice option, toggle flips a checkbox. Re-inspect afterwards; dispatch is not completion. Never bypass disabled controls.

tools.name: fiji_run_macro
tools.description: Run ImageJ macro code (IJ.runMacro) with an optional argument; returns the result and Log text (bounded). Pixel changes are checkpointed when possible; file effects are not. Prefer a structured tool or fiji_run_command first.

tools.name: fiji_run_script
tools.description: Run a SciJava script (groovy, python, javascript or ijm) in Fiji; returns its output and return value as text. Full local privileges: can read/write files or run code. Last resort after structured tools, fiji_run_command and fiji_run_macro.

tools.name: fiji_recorder
tools.description: Read the Macro Recorder text if it is open, otherwise Penny’s own journal of the IJ.run calls it made (steps and an equivalent macro). Read only.

tools.name: fiji_save_workflow
tools.description: Save the recorded steps as a reusable ImageJ macro (.ijm) in Penny’s workflow folder so the same procedure can run on other images. Returns the path, step count and macro text. Pick a short descriptive name yourself.

tools.name: fiji_make_macro
tools.description: Write an ImageJ macro (ijm; groovy or python when needed) for any procedure Fiji has no tool for, save it as a named workflow and test-run it on the active image (test default true). Params are passed as getArgument() key=value pairs. Returns ok, error and errorLine on failure, the Log, Results rows added and images opened. On an error fix the code and call again with the same name, silently, at most 3 times.

tools.name: fiji_workflows
tools.description: List saved workflows/macros (name, file, language, description, params, modified, lines), optionally filtered by query. Read only.

tools.name: fiji_run_workflow
tools.description: Run a saved workflow by name on the active image, every open image, or every matching file in a folder (target folder with an absolute folder and a pattern such as *.tif; limit files). Params override its defaults; saveResults writes one combined CSV. Returns processed, failed, per-image results and the CSV path.

tools.name: fiji_capture_macro
tools.description: Turn what Penny just did (the recorded steps, or only the lastSteps) into a reusable, tested macro saved under name. Use for “save what you just did / make this a workflow”. Returns the path, lines, tested and ok.

tools.name: fiji_save_image
tools.description: Save the active image as tiff, png or jpeg to an exact path or, by default, next to its source or into .local/exports. Returns the path.

tools.name: fiji_export_results
tools.description: Write the Results table as CSV into .local/exports (or an exact path). Returns the path and row count. No research data leaves this computer.

tools.name: fiji_checkpoint
tools.description: Snapshot the active image’s pixels, ROI, overlay and ROI Manager in memory (bounded 512 MiB) so fiji_restore can go back. Not a file save.

tools.name: fiji_checkpoints
tools.description: List in-memory checkpoints and which image each belongs to.

tools.name: fiji_compare
tools.description: Compare counts now (ROI Manager, overlay, Results rows) against a checkpoint. Read only.

tools.name: fiji_restore
tools.description: Restore a checkpoint’s pixels, ROI, overlay and ROI Manager for its image. Not a general undo for files, closed windows or scripts.

tools.name: fiji_close
tools.description: Close the active image, the image with id, or all images, without saving; unsaved changes are reported.

id.description: ImageJ image id exactly as fiji_context/fiji_images report it (ImageJ ids are negative integers).

tools.name: fiji_snapshot
tools.description: Capture only the active image canvas as PNG for visual inspection. No unrelated desktop content is captured.

tools.name: fiji_log
tools.description: Read the tail of the ImageJ Log window.

tools.name: fiji_status
tools.description: Read Fiji’s status bar text, whether a bridge command, macro or script is still running (analysisRunning) and the last dispatched operation. Use it to tell the researcher what Fiji is doing during a long step.

tools.name: fiji_plugins
tools.description: List installed plugin commands under Plugins>, optionally filtered by query. Read only.

tools.name: fiji_undo
tools.description: Undo the last pixel operation (Edit > Undo) when ImageJ can, otherwise restore the latest checkpoint. Returns what came back.

tools.name: fiji_knowledge
tools.description: Search Penny’s Fiji guidance and the locally downloaded official ImageJ documentation (user guide, menus, macro functions). Use before unfamiliar commands, filters, measurements, stacks or macros.

tools.name: fiji_find_images
tools.description: Find images on this computer by a loose name ("the blobs tif", "embryos"): searches Penny’s data folder, Desktop, Downloads and Documents. Use before fiji_open_path when the researcher names an image instead of a path; never ask them for a folder.

tools.name: fiji_action_status
tools.description: Read a recorded action (completed, failed, denied or expired) by ID. Decisions are taken by policy or the researcher in the companion; there is no model approval tool.

tools.name: fiji_desktop_inspect
tools.description: List the windows and actionable elements of Fiji (default), the frontmost app or any bundle ids via macOS Accessibility, including OS-owned open/save panels and alerts. Each element has a stable id, role, title/label/value, enabled and a global screen frame (top-left origin). Use the in-app fiji_ui / fiji_ui_action first; they see AWT/Swing controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, OS file choosers, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Always inspect immediately before acting: ids expire after 30 s. Reports trusted:false when Penny lacks the Accessibility permission, which only the researcher can grant.

tools.name: fiji_desktop_act
tools.description: Operate one element id from the latest fiji_desktop_inspect (within 30 s): press a button/menu item, toggle a checkbox, focus or select a row/tab/option, setValue or type into a field. Accessibility actions are tried first; otherwise Penny moves the real mouse to the element and clicks or types. The cursor flies there first. Use the in-app fiji_ui / fiji_ui_action first; they see AWT/Swing controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, OS file choosers, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Re-inspect afterwards; dispatch is not completion. Never bypass disabled controls.

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Penny’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: fiji_desktop_type
tools.description: Type text into whatever currently has keyboard focus (Fiji is brought forward first), optionally pressing Return after. For a file dialog: fiji_desktop_key ["cmd+shift+g"], then fiji_desktop_type the absolute path with submit true, then fiji_desktop_key ["return"] to open. Use the in-app fiji_ui / fiji_ui_action first; they see AWT/Swing controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, OS file choosers, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "sc.fiji.fiji" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Penny’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: fiji_desktop_key
tools.description: Press keyboard shortcuts in order, e.g. ["cmd+shift+g"] to open the path sheet in a file chooser, ["return"], ["escape"], ["tab"], ["cmd+o"]. Modifiers cmd/shift/alt/ctrl plus one key name (letters, digits, return, escape, tab, space, delete, arrows, f1-f12). Use the in-app fiji_ui / fiji_ui_action first; they see AWT/Swing controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, OS file choosers, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "sc.fiji.fiji" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Penny’s cursor while it flies to the target.

tools.name: fiji_desktop_click
tools.description: Click at exact global screen coordinates (top-left origin, from a frame returned by fiji_desktop_inspect) when no element id fits, e.g. a canvas or custom-drawn plugin control. Penny flies its cursor there, then moves the real mouse and clicks. Use the in-app fiji_ui / fiji_ui_action first; they see AWT/Swing controls directly. Use the desktop tools only for what they cannot see: OS file open/save dialogs, OS file choosers, third-party plugin windows, alerts and any other window on screen. Prefer fiji_desktop_act with an id whenever one exists.

app.description: Bundle id to bring forward first: "sc.fiji.fiji" (default), "frontmost" or "none".

label.description: Two to six words shown beside Penny’s cursor while it flies to the target.
